postgres.qualifies: Original native codec and old-factory read-safe reopen only; PostgreSQL also actual native dump/restore. No migration/continuation/public hydration proof.
postgres.engine: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Debian 16.15-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

privacy: Synthetic local fixture data only; authentic opaque grants/native/private data intentionally retained. No production credentials or user payloads are used. Audit is source-backed and finite, not a universal secret detector.
expiryPolicy: Authentic local grants MAY expire. Do not refresh expiry/token/obligation or assume positive consume; migration/read never dispatches.
